title: QRETRIG
author: Heal Youth
description: Quantized retrig: hold [TRIG 14], [TRIG 15] or [TRIG 16] (grid recording off) and the active audio track also fires every 4th, 2nd or single step, on the sequencer's grid. With grid recording on, or with [FUNC], the keys are stock. Their LEDs are bright blue while they are retrig keys, white while held.
